# PAYNE V6 MAINTENANCE-ONLY PREFLIGHT PROPOSAL
# REVIEW ONLY. NOT A DEPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION.
# Exact source: 3b2394e9559a77c0f8106d462ae3e3a0d1d0b7c3
# Gate baseline: 621a0f9fb237cd9defb420605dd5c384489a84bb
#
# This file deliberately does not replace the existing production safety gate.
# It documents the minimum, narrowly scoped historical-terminal condition
# change needed for code-only installation and the additional exposure proof
# that must be implemented/validated before activation.
#
# Existing gate conditions to retain:
# - Verified PAYNE_CONTROL_V2 schema; armed=false, openPositions=0,
#   requiredExchangeIndex=2, scanEnabled=true, numerical checks.
# - PAYNE_REAL_SERIES_V1 schema, owner, index checks.
# - Position ownership checks; reject active provider-post latches.
# - Pre/post matching of Founder control fingerprint and series state.
# - Fresh scheduler heartbeat, source SCHEDULED_CRON.
# - Fail closed on unknown claim, submission or provider exposure.
#
# ORIGINAL condition (in verify_safety jq):
# (.unresolvedEntry==false or
#   (.unresolvedEntry==true and $c[0].armed==false and
#    (.currentAttempt.status//""|IN("NO_PROVIDER_EXECUTION","PROVIDER_RECONCILED_NO_EXECUTION")) and
#    (.currentAttempt.reconciliationReason//""|IN("PROVIDER_RECONCILED_NO_EXECUTION"))))
#
# PROPOSED MAINTENANCE-ONLY exception, NOT FOR ARM:
# If unresolvedEntry=true with nonterminal classification, allow CODE INSTALL
# ONLY WHEN ALL following independently hold:
# - Founder remains DISARMED and no PAYNE-owned position exists
# - seriesId is exactly 367facf0-a0ab-4361-99b6-0dbe4c786660
# - currentAttempt.attemptId is exactly
#   367facf0-a0ab-4361-99b6-0dbe4c786660-intent-1
# - currentAttempt.marketTicker is exactly KXZEC15M-26OCT112315-15
# - currentAttempt.clientOrderId is exactly payne-real-0dbe4c786660-1-entry
# - writerInvoked is false; providerPostStarted is false; order ID is null
# - fireLatch.state is PRE_PROVIDER_VALIDATION and providerPost is NOT_STARTED
# - historical series is not mutated, classified, reset, or released
# - independently authenticated Kalshi orders, fills, settlements, positions
#   AND account-wide outstanding exposure verification is COMPLETE/CLEAN
#   immediately before install; missing/incomplete evidence FAILS CLOSED.
#
# As of preparation: independently authenticated exposure proof is NOT
# available in this workflow and the Durable Object claim remains unread.
# Therefore this proposal intentionally does not implement an executable
# bypass. Do not deploy on this file alone.
#
# IMPORTANT: a code install does NOT clear unresolvedEntry and does NOT arm.
# The separate, explicit Founder authorization to deploy remains mandatory.
